display_label: Window of heating and dormant properties

conceptual_meaning: Material properties remain largely dormant while heat changes the material state.

display_label: Window of direct association and coupled responses
window_logic: bounds the early cluster in which direct and coupled relationship curves rise and predominate
conceptual_meaning: Direct and coupled relationships are simultaneously influential.
user_notes: Existing broad window retained; geometry should derive from relationship segments rather than label position.

window_logic: small local window around the point where previously coupled trajectories approach zero / no longer coexist
conceptual_meaning: Previously coupled relationships diminish and cease to be simultaneously influential.

window_logic: local window around the transition where a competing influence becomes dominant after the early relationships collapse
conceptual_meaning: Another influence becomes more significant than the original direct/coupled relationships.
user_notes: Exact relationship membership to refine after rendering against reference.

window_logic: compact window around relationships that return after previously reaching zero or very low influence
conceptual_meaning: A relationship becomes influential again, but through a changed material history rather than the original coupling.

display_label: Window of possible capture under maintained stimulus
window_logic: one conceptual window with multiple spatial instances around relationships that could become retained if stimulus/state conditions persist
conceptual_meaning: Different relationships occupy different influence levels and may be captured if the relevant stimulus/state is maintained.
user_notes: Updated accessible label; use multiple window instances.

display_label: Window of captured properties & disconnected associations
window_logic: final broad state window containing both persistent/captured trajectories and relationships that have become disconnected
conceptual_meaning: The solid state preserves selected relationships while other earlier associations remain disconnected.
